abstract_operator: Divide an object or process into independent portions.
example_summary: A screwdriver is split into a bit holder and interchangeable drive bits.

abstract_operator: Separate a disturbing part or property while retaining what is needed.
example_summary: A reusable pencil separates its replaceable lead from the body.

abstract_operator: Give each region properties suited to its local operation.
example_summary: Socks have anti-slip knobs only on the underside where traction is needed.

abstract_operator: Replace symmetry with a form matched to unequal conditions.
example_summary: An asymmetric memory card geometry prevents insertion in the wrong orientation.

abstract_operator: Combine related objects or operations in space or time.
example_summary: Piezo ignition combines spark generation and gas release in one lighter action.

abstract_operator: Make one object perform several functions and remove redundant objects.
example_summary: A spork combines spoon and fork functions for backpacking.

abstract_operator: Place an object inside another or pass one through a cavity.
example_summary: A telescoping pointer retracts into a pocket-sized nested form.

abstract_operator: Counter an object's weight with lift or environmental forces.
example_summary: A hydrofoil lifts a boat hull from the water at speed, reducing drag.

abstract_operator: Prepare a counteraction before the required action creates its harmful effect.
example_summary: A spring-driven toy car is pulled backward first to tension its spring before moving forward.

abstract_operator: Complete useful preparation before the main operation begins.
example_summary: A coffee capsule contains a pre-portioned serving ready for brewing.

abstract_operator: Add a protective countermeasure in advance against unreliable or damaging conditions.
example_summary: A waste gate releases excess pressure before a pipe or tank can burst.

abstract_operator: Arrange operation to avoid working against a potential field.
example_summary: A service pit lets technicians work beneath a vehicle without lifting it.

abstract_operator: Invert the usual action, motion, or arrangement.
example_summary: A chemical ink eraser removes ink from paper, reversing the writing action of a pen.

abstract_operator: Replace linear or flat forms with curves, rotation, or spherical geometry.
example_summary: A wheel igniter replaces a straight scratching motion with rotating friction.

abstract_operator: Make form or position adjustable as operating conditions change.
example_summary: An office chair adjusts to different users and working requirements.

abstract_operator: Deliberately do somewhat more or less when exact completion is difficult.
example_summary: A stamp pad transfers extra ink so several marks can be made at once.

abstract_operator: Move an arrangement into another dimension or use another face of a surface.
example_summary: A wireless presenter places slide controls and a laser pointer on the mouse underside.

abstract_operator: Introduce oscillation or resonance to improve the useful effect.
example_summary: A vibrating toothbrush moves bristles between teeth to improve cleaning.

abstract_operator: Replace continuous action with pulses or useful pauses.
example_summary: A jack-hammer removes material through repeated impacts.

abstract_operator: Keep useful work active and remove idle or reverse motion.
example_summary: A printer head prints during both left-to-right and right-to-left passes.

abstract_operator: Perform a hazardous operation quickly enough to limit its harmful effect.
example_summary: A brief heat pulse neutralizes an insect-bite toxin without burning the skin.

abstract_operator: Use a harmful factor for a useful result or cancel harms against each other.
example_summary: Acid is alternated with alkali in a pipe so it removes the other's deposits.

abstract_operator: Feed output information back to regulate the operation.
example_summary: A thermostat opens or closes a heater valve according to measured air temperature.

abstract_operator: Insert an intermediary that transfers or carries out an action.
example_summary: A serpentine belt relays one engine's power to several vehicle loads.

abstract_operator: Make the object service itself or reuse its waste energy or material.
example_summary: A cistern filter uses part of incoming water to wash debris from its surface.

abstract_operator: Use a simpler, cheaper, or indirect copy in place of the original.
example_summary: A thermal camera maps invisible heat radiation into an observable image.

abstract_operator: Substitute inexpensive disposable objects for costly durable ones.
example_summary: Daily contact lenses are discarded after short use instead of lasting a month.

abstract_operator: Replace mechanical interaction with optical, acoustic, electrical, magnetic, or other fields.
example_summary: Radio control unlocks a vehicle without a mechanical tumbler cylinder.

abstract_operator: Replace solid parts with gas or liquid structures and cushions.
example_summary: Airbags provide passenger protection using an inflatable fluid-supported structure.

abstract_operator: Use thin flexible films or membranes for construction, isolation, or protection.
example_summary: A self-adhesive screen film protects a phone or laptop from scratches.

abstract_operator: Add pores or use porous inserts to create a useful function.
example_summary: A porous foam core between thin skins makes a lightweight durable panel.

abstract_operator: Change color, transparency, emissivity, or optical traces to reveal state.
example_summary: A pH strip changes color according to the acidity of the tested liquid.

abstract_operator: Make interacting objects of the same or closely compatible material.
example_summary: Biodegradable bags allow organic waste to enter compost without removal from the bag.

abstract_operator: Discard spent parts or restore them directly for renewed use.
example_summary: A box-cutter regains a sharp blade by snapping off its worn segment.

abstract_operator: Change state, concentration, flexibility, temperature, pressure, or another parameter.
example_summary: A soft glue stick hardens after application to provide its adhesive effect.

abstract_operator: Exploit heat, volume, or other phenomena of a phase change.
example_summary: Expanding ice inside a mold shapes a metal shell by exerting force during freezing.

abstract_operator: Use thermal expansion or differing expansion coefficients.
example_summary: Tapered rings with different expansion coefficients compensate bearing clearance.

abstract_operator: Increase oxidation strength using enriched, ionized, or otherwise stronger oxidizing conditions.
example_summary: An oxygen converter blows pure oxygen through molten iron to make low-carbon steel.

abstract_operator: Replace a reactive environment with vacuum, inert gas, or neutral material.
example_summary: An incandescent bulb uses evacuated or inert-filled space to protect its tungsten filament.

abstract_operator: Combine distinct materials so their complementary properties work together.
example_summary: TetraPak packaging layers paperboard, plastic, and aluminium for different functions.
